{{Top|leg}}
A '''biofeedback system''' was a type of [[armor accessory]] that monitored the vital signs of the wearer and could administer various [[Meditation/Legends|medications]]. Notable types of biofeedback systems included the [[NG-7 vital system]] and the [["Autodoc" monitoring network]].<ref name="FDCR">''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
